title: Personal Records Detection
dataSources: Strava API activities (`strava:activity`), Garmin Connect (`garmin:activity`), Fitbit Web API (`fitbit:activity`), Peloton workout history (`peloton:workout`).
app: Strava / Garmin Connect / Fitbit / Peloton / Zwift APIs and webhooks via Splunk HEC scripted inputs; GPX/FIT/CSV activity exports ingested as file inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=strava:activity type=Run
| eval pace_min_km=(moving_time_s/60)/distance_km
| streamstats min(pace_min_km) as best_pace_so_far
| eval is_pr=if(pace_min_km<=best_pace_so_far,1,0)
| where is_pr=1
| table _time distance_km pace_min_km
description: Scans your run history in time order and flags each activity that set a new best pace, giving you an automatic personal-records log.
value: Celebrating personal records is a proven motivator; detecting them automatically means you never miss a milestone buried in the activity feed.
implementation: Ingest Strava runs; schedule after each sync and notify yourself when a new best is detected. Split by distance band for distance-specific records.
visualization: Table of record-setting activities with a marker on the pace timeline.
grandmaExplanation: It spots when you have just run your fastest ever and lets you celebrate the new record.
